newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PSE drifts lower, further falls expected.
newsitem.headline: Czech PSE drifts lower, further falls expected.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange closed the week down in another day of listelss trading, as the market continues to drift lower and analysts predicting more of the same next week.

The PX50 index edged down 1.4 points to 555.5, while the Reuters RPIX index measuring the seven continuously traded shares three points to 1,129. It was the fourth consecutive session the bourse fell.
Pulling the market lower were losses to Komercni Banka, CEZ, Ceska Sporitelna and SPT Telecom. Overall, decliners outpaced advancers by 169 to 149, with 67 shares trading unchanged.
Total turnover was modest at 634,984, most of which came in the form of direct and block trades, on turnover of 699.8 million crowns.
Dealers said they saw no end in sight for the market's slumber, noting the lack foreign participation should continue to push the bourse lower.
"The market is extremely quiet, and volumes are low. (And) with no fresh money coming into the market, I don't expect the trend to change at all," said Marco Anderegg of Patria Finance.
